values: Methodology, feature definitions, and leakage controls
Development window only: 2026-06-29 through 2026-08-18 America/Chicago. Warm-up history begins 2026-05-31 19:00 CT. Unseen OOS files were not accessed.
Exactly 42 frozen Confirm trades: 17 wins, 25 losses, AvgR -0.00846, TotalR -0.35512, PF 0.98369, MaxDD 8.37128R after the existing $14.50 cost assumption.
Phase 3 structure, Phase 4 liquidity, Phase 5 scoring/Variant-C, funnel, entries, stops, targets, sessions, HTF rules, cooldown, anti-chase, and Pine remained unchanged.
Setup <= BOS < Retest < Confirmation = Entry is asserted trade by trade. All features use data known by the entry-bar close.
Attributed from the frozen SetupEngine state after each exact canonical setup; the five components are asserted to sum to the frozen canonical score.
Direction-signed BOS close change from the prior bar close. Close distance beyond stored structure is reported separately.
BOS volume divided by the mean of the prior 20 completed bars. The BOS bar is excluded from the denominator.
Measured causally from BOS+1 through the accepted retest. Touch count includes the accepted touch.
Known entry-bar ATR compared with up to 100 completed prior bars; current entry bar is excluded from the reference distribution.
Cumulative CME-session high and low through the entry bar only.
Win/loss, gross/net R, MFE, MAE, exit timestamp, and exit reason are labels only and are excluded from the feature registry.
Cohen d is descriptive, not a significance test.
STABLE: all leave-one-out signs agree and minimum absolute effect >=75% of full. PARTIALLY STABLE: >=90% sign agreement and >=50% effect retention.
Remove best trade, worst trade, top two winners, and top two losers separately.
Quantiles and simple fixed delay/score bands are descriptive only. Every requested bucket study was non-monotonic.
Exactly 10 economically justified pairs using median or existing structural splits; no unrestricted combination search.

Setup and BOS share the same bar in 41 of 42 trades, so most setup/BOS candle-shape fields are duplicates rather than independent evidence. Raw upper/lower wick effects also require direction-aware interpretation.
